title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Mega-cap tech ripped, bonds bid, oil crashed. The tape was a straight AI-hardware repricing on Palantir’s blowout and an energy unwind from de-escalation hopes, with breadth confirming rather than leading. This was a high-conviction, high-beta chase into growth, not a broad risk-on melt-up.

INDICES — SOXX +6.80%, QQQ +3.40%, IWM +1.85%, SPY +1.80%, DIA +1.73%. Small > large by 1.55pp. WTI -5.19% was the cross-asset anchor; TLT +0.77% while SPY hit record. SPY and QQQ both above 200-day MA.

VOLUME — SPY 1.5x avg, QQQ 1.5x avg — both elevated on strong up-days, textbook accumulation. DIA 1.9x confirms index-level participation, but IWM at 1.0x shows small caps were bystanders. XLV 1.7x on a down day is the only distribution signal.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK Technology +4.98%, XLB Materials +1.94%, XLI Industrials +1.77%, XLF Financials +0.87%, XLC Comms +0.63%, XLP Staples +0.60%, XLY Discretionary +0.07%, XLRE Real Estate -0.02%, XLV Healthcare -0.09%, XLE Energy -0.46%, XLU Utilities -0.56%. Top industries: DRAM +7.35%, SOXX +6.80%; bottom: WGMI -3.65%, USO -5.19%. Money exiting energy/power-names into semis; label: AI hardware leading.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.19 shows put demand, but QQQ PCR 0.79 is complacent. GEX flips at 767 (SPY) and 703 (QQQ) sit just above spot, so dealer hedging can amplify upside. VIX 16.5 is below its 20-day MA of 17.3 — fear is fading; MOVE 77.6 vs 70 MA flags bond-vol stress.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -5.19% funded the equity bid: Treasury yields fell, cutting September hike odds to 56.9%, while TLT +0.77%. Gold +0.66% with a weak dollar (UUP -0.04%) is a quiet bid, not a risk-off hedge.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed 65.8. PLTR +29.45% on hypergrowth AI earnings, 5.2x vol — accumulation; VST -8.15% on 3.0x vol — distribution in power names. Watch MRVL +12.81% (option-driven, gamma squeeze risk), INTC +10.84% (momentum break above range), and XLK +4.98% (20d momentum now +4.31%, trend inflecting).
